title: India's defence production just hit a record Rs 1.78 lakh crore
sources: Business Today - India's defence production surges to all-time high to Rs 1.78 lakh crore
Janes - India's defence production value rises to INR1.78 trillion
caption:
India's defence production just hit a record Rs 1.78 lakh crore. And the private sector's share just grew too.

India's defence production reached an all-time high of Rs 1.78 lakh crore in FY 2025-26, a 15.6% jump over the previous year. Public sector units still supply the majority, but the private sector's share rose to 24% of total output - about Rs 42,000 crore - up from 22% the year before. This sits alongside a separate record for defence exports, which hit Rs 38,424 crore in the same financial year.

A decade ago, India imported most of its defence equipment. Now it manufactures Rs 1.78 lakh crore worth a year - and more of that is coming from private companies, not just government factories.
